ProgramName: Professional Studies Graduate Certificate in Ministry
Description: The Professional Studies Graduate Certificate in Ministry is a unique academic program designed to help prepare participants to best proclaim the gospel in response to the legacy of concerns caused by the impact of Covid-19 on ministerial efforts in five specific areas.  The Certificate is a great choice for those who already have a degree, but would like to stay current within the field, and for those who are interested in elevating their career options without the expense of a master's degree.
ScholarshipType: Military, First Time Freshmen, Ministers, Corporate Alliance

ProgramName: Master of Arts in Interdisciplinary Studies
Concentration: Business Administration, Counseling, Marriage and Family Therapy, Leadership, Ministry, Biblical Studies
Description: The Master of Arts in Interdisciplinary Studies allows students to combine two academic disciplines to create a graduate program specific to their career goals and interests.  This unique degree program can be personalized for students' whose career needs are not satisfied by traditional degree plans.  Upon acceptance, the student will choose courses from multiple disciplines and design an individual plan of study with guidance from a Faculty Mentor and Academic Advisor.
ProgramCategory: Interdisciplinary Studies##Business Administration##Counseling##Marriage and Family Therapy##Theology##Humanities
ScholarshipType: Federal Financial Aid, Military Students, First Time Freshmen, Ministers, Corporate Alliance partners

ProgramName: Master of Arts in Marriage and Family Therapy
Description: The Master of Arts (MA) in Marriage and Family Therapy is a professional-level degree program where experiences provide the foundation for marriage and family therapy theory, scientific research, and clinical practice.  Students learn the different approaches and clinical techniques required for today's practitioners offering therapeutic services to individuals, couples, and families.  A major goal of this program is to help prepare students for licensure in Marriage and Family Therapy in their resident state.

ProgramName: Master of Arts in Professional Counseling
Description: The Master of Arts (MA) in Professional Counseling provides a foundation in psychology theory, scientific research, and clinical practice, preparing students for licensure in Professional Counseling.  Graduates are equipped to offer therapeutic services in various settings like churches, private practices, and community agencies.  The program also serves as a basis for advanced studies in related fields.

ProgramName: Master of Arts in Christian Education
Description: The Master of Arts in Christian Education is a 36-semester-hour program designed to be completed in four semesters. The curriculum focuses on developing a biblical philosophy of Christian education and effective leadership skills for church settings and other organizations. It also emphasizes the use of sound interpretation principles for biblical texts and the application of curriculum and instruction principles.
ScholarshipType: Military Students, First Time Freshmen, Ministers, Corporate Alliance partners, Federal Financial Aid

ProgramName: Master of Arts in New Testament Studies
Description: The Master of Arts (MA) in New Testament Studies is a graduate degree that offers a specialization in the New Testament of the Bible.  Courses include the study of texts in the Greek New Testament, New Testament backgrounds, and on proper contextual interpretation.  This program provides a foundation for students to pursue a Doctor of Philosophy in Biblical Studies in New Testament.
ScholarshipType: Military Students, First Time Freshmen, Ministers, and Corporate Alliance partners

ProgramName: Master of Arts in Old Testament Studies
Description: The Master of Arts in Old Testament Studies offers a specialization in the Old Testament of the Bible, with courses covering texts in the Hebrew Old Testament, Old Testament backgrounds, and proper contextual interpretation. This program emphasizes proficiency in the Hebrew language and scholarly biblical research and writing. It is designed to provide a strong foundation for students who intend to pursue a Doctor of Philosophy in Biblical Studies in the Old Testament.

ProgramName: Master of Business Administration
Description: The Master of Business Administration (MBA) at Amridge University provides practical training in finance, accounting, information systems, research, and ethical leadership.  The program is designed for those looking to advance their current careers or move into leadership roles.  Graduates are prepared for work in corporate, non-profit, and Christian ministry settings.
ScholarshipType: Military, First Time Freshmen, Ministers, Corporate Alliance partners

ProgramName: Master of Divinity
Concentration: Ministerial Leadership, Marriage and Family Therapy, Professional Counseling
Description: The Master of Divinity (MDiv) degree prepares qualified persons to be effective Christian ministers and church leaders who will use their gifts and knowledge in proclaiming the gospel, strengthening the church, and serving humanity. The program is biblical in orientation with exposure to theological and historical studies, seeking to provide Christian service that is both scholarly and relevant to contemporary life.
ScholarshipType: Merit-based, Need-based, Military Students, First Time Freshmen, Ministers, Corporate Alliance partners

ProgramName: Master of Divinity in Marriage and Family Therapy
Description: The Master of Divinity (MDiv) in Marriage and Family Therapy is a professional-level degree program for individuals planning to enter or continue careers in full-time ministry. This program provides students with extensive studies in the biblical text and thorough preparation in theology and practical ministry. It also provides a foundation for marriage and family therapy theory, scientific research, and clinical practice, helping prepare students for licensure in Marriage and Family Therapy (LMFT).

ProgramName: Master of Divinity in Professional Counseling
Description: The Master of Divinity (MDiv) in Professional Counseling is a professional-level degree program for individuals planning to enter or continue careers in full-time ministry. This program provides students with extensive studies in biblical text and thorough preparation in theology, while also offering a foundation in psychology theory, scientific research, and clinical practice to prepare them for state licensure as a Professional Counselor (LPC).

ProgramName: Master of Divinity in Ministerial Leadership
Description: The Master of Divinity (MDiv) in Ministerial Leadership is a professional-level degree program for individuals planning to enter or continue careers in full-time ministry. A major element of this program provides students with extensive studies in the biblical text and thorough preparation in theology and various areas of practical ministry. The program prepares students for admission to more advanced studies, such as the Doctor of Ministry degree program.

ProgramName: Master of Science in Christian Ministry
Description: The Master of Science (MS) in Christian Ministry is designed to prepare students to serve more effectively in their respective ministry environments. Students will receive advanced ministerial training via the core course requirements and may select from a variety of elective courses to enhance their training in a specific area of interest. This program provides a proper foundation for students to pursue more advanced studies and is open to applicants who hold a four-year bachelor's degree in any field of study.

ProgramName: Master of Science in Human Services
Description: The Master of Science in Human Services is a non-licensure program designed to introduce students to the dynamics of human development and interaction.  Students will develop an in-depth understanding of the primary models, theories, and techniques used in individual, group, and family counseling.  This program prepares graduates to work in settings such as private life coaching, church settings, governmental agencies, or community agencies.
ProgramCategory: Human Services##Counseling##Social Work and Human Services
ScholarshipType: Merit-based, Corporate Alliance Award, Accelerated Degree Grant Program

ProgramName: Master of Science in Leadership and Management
Description: The Master of Science in Leadership and Management is designed to provide graduates with critical skills and knowledge for today's competitive workplace.  The program emphasizes team building, leadership development, conflict resolution, and other management skills within a context of ethical and moral approaches.

ProgramName: Master of Science in Ministerial Leadership
Description: The Master of Science in Ministerial Leadership is a professional-level degree designed to prepare students for work in Christian ministry with a practitioner's approach to Biblical studies.  This program provides a foundation for students to pursue more advanced studies and degree programs.  Upon completion, graduates will be able to demonstrate knowledge of leadership principles, effectively make decisions, communicate, and address conflict while leading an organization from a values-based position.

ProgramName: Doctor of Education in Higher Education Administration
Description: The Doctor of Education in Higher Education Administration curriculum prepares current and future leaders for executive level positions within postsecondary institutions. With a programmatic emphasis in research, institutional effectiveness, student services, curriculum development, finance, law, and future trends, students will develop the theoretical skills necessary to effectively address real-world problems within higher education.
ScholarshipType: Federal Financial Aid, Military Students, First Time Freshmen, Ministers, Corporate Alliance

ProgramName: Doctor of Ministry
Description: The Doctor of Ministry (DMin) degree program is for qualified persons currently engaged in ministry. The program's goal is to develop effective Christian ministers by combining theological reflection with continued spiritual growth, leading to greater competence in ministerial skills. The curriculum utilizes the candidate's own work setting as a primary learning resource, with much of the coursework involving in-service projects.

ProgramName: Doctor of Ministry in Family Therapy I
Description: The Doctor of Ministry (DMin) in Family Therapy I is an advanced professional degree designed for those in community organizations and church-related vocations. This program integrates academic knowledge with practical application to prepare students for ministry focused on family therapy and counseling.

ProgramName: Doctor of Ministry in Family Therapy II
Concentration: Counseling with Couples, Counseling with Families, Counseling with Individuals
Description: The Doctor of Ministry (DMin) in Family Therapy II is an advanced professional degree for community organizations and church-related vocations. This degree has three concentrations designed to prepare participants to counsel with couples, families, and individuals. Being a capstone program, it infuses academics and practice to prepare students for family therapy and counseling ministry and is designed for students who have a Master of Divinity in a related field.
ScholarshipType: Grants, Scholarships, Loans, Military Students, First Time Freshmen, Ministers, Corporate Alliance partners

ProgramName: Doctor of Philosophy in Biblical Studies – New Testament
Description: The Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Biblical Studies program is designed to prepare students for academic teaching, research, and scholarly writing in the fields of Old or New Testament.  Students choose one of these as a concentration and will complete a comprehensive examination and a dissertation in that area.  The curriculum equips students with critical skills for analyzing, interpreting, and explaining biblical texts, preparing them for roles in universities, seminaries, and for higher-level service to the church.

ProgramName: Doctor of Philosophy in Biblical Studies – Old Testament
Description: The Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) degree in Biblical Studies aims to equip students for academic teaching, research, and scholarly writing in the fields of Old Testament and New Testament. The program is designed to prepare students to teach Bible and biblical languages in academic institutions and to produce scholarly work. This rigorous, research-oriented study consists of 51 semester hours beyond a relevant master's degree.

ProgramName: Doctor of Philosophy in Interdisciplinary Studies
Concentration: Counseling, Marriage and Family Therapy, Leadership, Ministry, Biblical Studies
Description: The Doctor of Philosophy in Interdisciplinary Studies is designed to prepare students for academic teaching, research, and service in a variety of professions in which interpersonal relationships are of great importance.  Upon acceptance, students choose courses from multiple disciplines such as Counseling, Marriage and Family Therapy, Leadership, Ministry, and Biblical Studies to design an individual plan of study.  This flexibility attracts students from various academic and professional backgrounds including human services, business, education, and ministry.

ProgramName: Doctor of Philosophy in Marriage and Family Therapy
Concentration: Quality Practice and Fiscal Systems, Teaching Practicum
Description: The Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Marriage and Family Therapy at Amridge University is a 60-semester hour, research-oriented program designed for students who have already completed the coursework for professional licensure. The program focuses on intensive studies in marriage and family therapy theories, human development, abuse and addiction, cultural diversity, and research. This program is delivered through a combination of traditional classroom settings and online formats.

ProgramName: Doctor of Philosophy in Organizational Leadership and Management
Description: The Doctor of Philosophy in Organizational Leadership and Management is an advanced degree program designed for professionals who desire to incorporate research-driven strategies and evidence-based concepts into their work. Throughout this course of study, students will improve their research skills and enhance their ability to lead and manage in diverse environments, equipping them to address the most prevalent challenges organizations face today.

ProgramName: Doctor of Philosophy in Professional Counseling
Concentration: Quality Practice and Fiscal Systems, Teaching Practicum
Description: Offered through the Amridge University School of Human Services, the Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) Degree in Professional Counseling is a 60-semester hour rigorous research-oriented program designed for students who have already completed the coursework required for professional licensure.  The program focuses on intensive studies in counseling theories, human development, abuse and addiction, cultural diversity, and research.  This degree is not intended to lead to professional licensure but rather to build upon existing credentials with advanced scholarship and therapeutic expertise.

ProgramName: Doctor of Philosophy in Biblical Studies
Description: The Doctor of Philosophy (PhD) in Biblical Studies is a rigorous, research-oriented program designed to equip students for academic teaching, research, and scholarly writing in the fields of Old Testament and New Testament.  This 51-semester-hour program prepares graduates for teaching roles in universities, seminaries, and colleges, as well as for higher-level service to the church.  Students will develop skills in original research and the competent use of biblical languages like Hebrew and Greek.
ScholarshipType: Federal Financial Aid, Military, Ministers, Corporate Alliance

ProgramName: Associate of Arts in Business Administration
Description: The Associate of Arts in Business Administration program provides students with the opportunity to complete an initial college degree while establishing a solid academic foundation for a bachelor's degree in business.  Graduates will be prepared in the essential areas of accounting, management, and marketing.  The program requires 64 semester credit hours, including general education, core business courses, and electives.
ScholarshipType: Merit-based, Need-based, Corporate Alliance, First-time Freshman

ProgramName: Associate of Arts in Human Resource Leadership
Description: The Associate of Arts in Human Resource Leadership program provides students with opportunities to complete an initial college degree while establishing a solid academic foundation for a bachelor's degree in business and human resources.  Students will study human effort, relationships, and leadership, as well as how to secure and maintain those who make up the organization.  Upon completion, graduates will be able to analyze basic business concepts and demonstrate entry-level skills in areas like organizational behavior, management information systems, and management communication.

ProgramName: Associate of Arts in Information Systems Management
Description: The Associate of Arts in Information Systems Management program provides students with opportunities to complete an initial college degree while establishing a solid academic foundation for a bachelor's degree in the field of information systems.  Upon completing the associate degree, a student may have completed one-half of the requirements for a bachelor's degree.  The program is designed to equip students with basic knowledge of business principles and the ability to plan, acquire, and build information systems in a business setting.

ProgramName: Associate of Arts in Web Development
Description: The Associate of Arts in Web Development program provides students with opportunities to complete an initial college degree while establishing a solid academic foundation for a bachelor's degree in the field of business.  This associate degree requires 20 credit hours of general education and 44 credit hours of prescribed core courses.  Upon completing the associate degree, a student may have completed one-half of the requirements for a bachelor's degree.

ProgramName: Bachelor of Science in Business Administration
Description: The Bachelor of Science in Business Administration degree is designed to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the functional areas of business. The curriculum equips students with the knowledge and skills necessary for careers in both the private and public sectors, focusing on the integration of business principles with Christian ethics and values.

ProgramName: Bachelor of Science in Human Resource Leadership
Description: The Bachelor of Science in Human Resource Leadership emphasizes enhancing human effort, relationships, and leadership within an organization. The curriculum focuses on securing, maintaining, and effectively working with personnel, including screening employees, training, human-relations, forecasting, and developing compensation systems. This program prepares students for careers in management, public relations, and government work, and serves as a foundation for various graduate degrees.

ProgramName: Bachelor of Science in Information Systems Management
Concentration: information systems security, network systems, data communications systems, wireless technologies, voice-over-IP systems, training and development in information services, web design, applications management, collaboration technologies
Description: The Bachelor of Science in Information Systems Management focuses on computer workstations, networks, intranets, and the Internet. The curriculum also covers training employees on these systems, establishing web servers, and maintaining the security of Internet and Intranet systems.

ProgramName: Bachelor of Science in Management
Description: This program combines the strengths of traditional management principles and practices with the art and science of traditional and emerging communication strategies to provide the essentials required for a successful career in business and the Christian community. Graduates are prepared in essential areas such as management, leadership, team building, decision-making, and critical thinking. The curriculum exposes students to theories, operations, and practices in both for-profit and nonprofit arenas.
ScholarshipType: Merit-based, Corporate Alliance Award, Accelerated Degree Grant, Undergraduate First-time Freshman Scholarship, Home School Student Award, Public Service Tuition Scholarship

ProgramName: Associate of Arts in Criminal Justice
Description: The Associate of Arts in Criminal Justice program provides students with the knowledge and skills needed for successful work in various organizations that offer public safety and law enforcement services.  It is designed to help students complete an initial college degree and establish a strong academic foundation for a bachelor's degree in criminal justice.  Students will examine criminal behavior, the investigative process, and legal aspects of the criminal justice system.

ProgramName: Associate of Arts in Legal Studies
Description: The Associate of Arts in Legal Studies is a multidisciplinary degree that combines general education with introductory elements of Criminal Justice, Human Resource Leadership, Human Development, and Ministry.  It is designed to prepare working professionals to better address legal and societal influences in their jobs and communities.

ProgramName: Associate of Arts in Liberal Studies
Description: The Associate of Arts in Liberal Studies provides a multidisciplinary degree focusing on skills for academic transfer, career readiness, and lifelong learning. This program allows students to complete general education requirements and customize their studies to align with professional goals and personal interests. Upon completion, a student may have fulfilled half the requirements for a bachelor's degree.
ScholarshipType: Merit-based, Need-based, Military, Ministers, Corporate Alliance

ProgramName: Bachelor of Science in Criminal Justice
Description: The Bachelor of Science in Criminal Justice program is designed to complement an individual's existing skills by incorporating general knowledge, human relations, and development skills.  It also covers communication skills, principles of justice, and the application of organizational and leadership principles necessary for success in today's public safety and law enforcement organizations.  This program integrates courses in human relations, criminal justice, organization, communication, and leadership to prepare students for upward mobility within public safety agencies, community non-profit organizations, and church organizations.
ScholarshipType: Merit-based, Need-based, Corporate Alliance, First-time Freshman

ProgramName: Bachelor of Science in Human Development
Description: This program is designed as a gateway to the Amridge University Master of Science Degree program with concentrations in Family Therapy or in Counseling. Graduates will be prepared in the dynamics of human relations and interactions that are critical in all positions relying on close working relationships. Students will be introduced to human development, motivation, introductory counseling theories and practices, aging, and diversity.

ProgramName: Associate of Arts in Ministry/Bible
Description: The Associate of Arts in Ministry/Bible program provides students with the opportunity to complete an initial college degree while establishing a solid academic foundation for a bachelor's degree in the field of ministry.  The program's goal is to prepare students for service in the church as ministers, elders, deacons, missionaries, and Bible teachers, as well as for allied Christian leadership positions.  Upon completion, a student may have fulfilled half of the requirements for a bachelor's degree.

ProgramName: Bachelor of Arts in Biblical Studies
Description: The Bachelor of Arts in Biblical Studies is a comprehensive professional program designed to prepare students for various service roles within the church, such as pulpit ministers, elders, deacons, missionaries, and Bible teachers.  It also aims to equip students for Christian leadership positions in youth services, as ministers of education, or as chaplains in various institutions.  The program emphasizes a scholarly approach to get students ready for advanced degrees like a Master of Arts in New Testament or Old Testament Studies.

ProgramName: Bachelor of Science in Ministry/Bible
Description: The Bachelor of Science in Ministry/Bible is a comprehensive professional program with a practitioner's focus designed to prepare students for various service roles within the church, such as pulpit ministers, elders, deacons, missionaries, and Bible teachers.  This program also provides a solid foundation for students who wish to pursue advanced degrees in religious studies.  It helps prepare students for allied Christian leadership positions in areas like youth services, ministers of education, or chaplains in hospitals and other institutions.
